title: "Verify addresses before sending"

---

```http
POST /v1/addresses/verify
```

Checks up to 100 addresses: syntax, whether the domain accepts mail (MX, the A/AAAA fallback, RFC 7505 null MX), disposable-address providers, role accounts (`info@`, `support@`), and this environment's suppressions and bulk unsubscribes. It sends no mail and never connects to the recipient's mail server, so `deliverable` means the domain accepts mail, not that the mailbox exists. `unknown` means DNS did not answer in time; try again later. Any key with `emails:send`, `emails:send_raw` or `addresses:verify` may call it.

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `addresses:verify` or `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw`.

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | no | One address. |
| `emails` | array of string | no | at most 100 items. |

Example:

```json
{
  "emails": [
    "ada@example.com",
    "info@example.com"
  ]
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body := []byte(`{"emails":["ada@example.com","info@example.com"]}`)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/addresses/verify", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

## Responses

### 200

One result per address, in request order

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `results` | array of object | no | &nbsp; |
| `results[].email` | string | yes | The address, normalised when the syntax is valid. |
| `results[].result` | "deliverable" \| "risky" \| "undeliverable" \| "unknown" | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].reasons` | array of "invalid_syntax" \| "null_mx" \| "no_mail_server" \| "dns_timeout" \| "disposable_domain" \| "role_account" \| "suppressed" | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].syntax_valid` | boolean | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].domain` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `results[].mx` | array of string | no | Mail servers for the domain, sorted. |
| `results[].disposable` | boolean | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].role_account` | boolean | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].suppressed` | boolean | yes | On this environment's suppression list; mail to it is refused. |
| `results[].unsubscribed` | boolean | yes | Unsubscribed from bulk mail in this environment. |

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "email": "user@example.org",
      "result": "deliverable",
      "reasons": [
        "invalid_syntax"
      ],
      "syntax_valid": false,
      "domain": "string",
      "mx": [
        "string"
      ],
      "disposable": false,
      "role_account": false,
      "suppressed": false,
      "unsubscribed": false
    }
  ]
}
```

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ip_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "emails_required"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `missing_scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope this call needs |
| `invalid_json` | 400 | The body is not valid JSON |
| `emails_required` | 422 | Address verification: no `email` or `emails` given |
| `too_many_addresses` | 422 | Address verification: more than 100 addresses in one request |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Storage was unavailable. Nothing was accepted |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
